verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (intro, then the big KENNER BAPTIST CHURCH headline, then the rotated date, address and candles) and the candles stay a strong anchor at the bottom. But the white frame breaks into odd fragments that end partway down the sides, the address block runs almost to the left edge, the rotated date is tiny, and the intro wraps awkwardly ('WEEKEND' sits alone on its line). B jams all the copy into the top third, leaves an empty white frame as a big dead box in the middle, pushes the rotated date to the bottom, and shrinks the candles to a tiny, cropped corner mark, so the key image is lost and the space is badly unbalanced.
